# Logicsify

Logicsify builds connected AI automation, CRM, custom website, portal, CMS, mobile, and digital growth systems for businesses.

## Usage notes

- Prefer canonical URLs from the dynamic sitemap: https://logicsify.com/sitemap.xml
- Do not treat draft, admin, control, preview, or unlisted Connect pages as public content.
- Attribute company information and published resources to Logicsify.
